summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Zendesk Sidebar App feature. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all critical elements working correctly: Sidebar App card with download button, install instructions, API key management (input, copy, regenerate).
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - sidebar API key follows 'zsk_' prefix convention for easy identification
ZIP download endpoint correctly generates manifest.json dynamically with frameworkVersion '2.0' and proper parameters
Sidebar generate endpoint properly validates X-Sidebar-Key header and returns appropriate 401 errors
Old sidebar key correctly becomes invalid after regeneration (tested and verified)
ZAF app assets (iframe.html, main.js, style.css) are well-structured with proper dark theme styling
Frontend Sidebar App card correctly shows 3-step installation process with all required UI elements
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing seeded zendesk_config with subdomain 'midnight-gd'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zendesk Sidebar App feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/admin/zendesk/sidebar-key (returns sidebar_api_key starting with 'zsk_'), POST /api/admin/zendesk/sidebar-key/regenerate (rotates key, old key becomes invalid), POST /api/zendesk/sidebar/generate (requires X-Sidebar-Key header, returns 401 'Missing sidebar API key' without header, 401 'Invalid sidebar API key' with wrong key), GET /api/admin/zendesk/sidebar-app.zip (downloads ZIP with manifest.json, assets/iframe.html, assets/main.js, assets/style.css). Frontend page at /admin/zendesk has Sidebar App card (data-testid='zendesk-sidebar-card') with download button (data-testid='zendesk-download-sidebar-btn'), key input (data-testid='zendesk-sidebar-key-input'), copy button (data-testid='zendesk-sidebar-key-copy-btn'), regenerate button (data-testid='zendesk-sidebar-key-regen-btn'). The sidebar card appears below the Webhook Setup card when Zendesk is connected.

Frontend Regenerate button with data-testid='zendesk-sidebar-key-regen-btn'

features_tested.details: Card order is correct: Connection → Integration Status → Response Mode → Webhook Setup → Sidebar App

features_tested.details: Callback URL /api/zendesk/oauth/callback is present in page when OAuth setup is shown

note: The sidebar/generate endpoint correctly authenticates via X-Sidebar-Key header and attempts to fetch ticket from Zendesk. Since the OAuth token in the seeded config is a placeholder ('test_token_placeholder'), the Zendesk API call fails with 'authorization expired' - this is EXPECTED behavior and confirms the auth flow works correctly. Copy button clipboard functionality cannot be fully tested in automated browser environment due to clipboard permission restrictions, but the UI implementation is correct.
